verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search/LLM API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only Perplexity-hosted services (search, Agent API, open-weight models 'hosted by Perplexity', remote MCP at api.perplexity.ai) and no option to run the core service on your own infrastructure. The open-source local MCP server and the CLI are client-side wrappers that still call Perplexity's hosted API, so they earn no credit toward self-hosting.
